profile.reading: OptimumHQ, marketed as OptimumAI, is a software company that builds AI-powered ERP, CRM, and business-automation tools for small and midsize businesses. The company's own website lists its office at 70 South Val Vista Drive in Gilbert, Arizona, while the address on file for this listing is 1955 South Val Vista Drive in neighboring Mesa. Val Vista Drive runs through both cities, so the discrepancy may reflect a past office location, a mapping error, or a different suite in a shared complex. Either way, OptimumHQ is a software business rather than a data center or colocation operator, and nothing publicly available indicates server or data center infrastructure at either address.

reading.body:
OptimumHQ is a software company tagged as a data center, and it publishes no power figure, no operator, and no specifications. It is a mapping error, not compute capacity.

The pattern is that a data center tag is not evidence of a data center. Arizona has 56 mapped facilities carrying data center tags, but only 4 publish power consumption figures, totaling 512 MW. The remaining 52, including this one, contribute to a facility count without contributing any measurable load. Here the stored coordinates in Mesa reverse geocode to a bare street address with no business name, and that same address appears separately for another unrelated registry row, which points to a shared multi-tenant building rather than a dedicated facility. The company's own site lists an address in Gilbert, several miles from the stored point.

This matters for AI because grid constraint analysis turns on which buildings actually draw power, not on how many addresses carry a tag. A row like this inflates the count of Arizona data centers while adding nothing to the 512 MW that is actually documented. Any per-facility average computed across all 56 entries would be wrong by construction, since the denominator includes software offices and shared buildings.

What the data does not say is how many of the other Arizona entries are mistagged the same way, or whether OptimumHQ runs any servers at all. It says only that nothing published indicates server or data center infrastructure at either address, and that the address discrepancy itself remains unresolved.
